name: Level 1 AC Charger (typically 16A 120V 1.9KW or 13-16A 240V 3KW) may incorporate standard domestic power cord.
Level 2 AC Charger (up to 80A, 208-240V AC, up to 20kW from single- or three-phase AC) cables permanently fixed to charging station.
Level 3 DC Charger or fast charger (up to 400A, up to 600V DC, up to 240KW)
